name: Darlanka Praneeth
title: Software Engineer at GE Vernova
tagline: I build Java services and Angular interfaces for industrial IoT software.
about: I'm a software engineer at GE Vernova in Hyderabad. For the past year and a half I've worked on industrial IoT software: Spring Boot services that expose GraphQL, and the Angular interfaces that sit on top of them.

Most of my work happens where the two meet. I connect an API to a screen, trace a defect from the UI down to the service that caused it, and turn one-off components into ones that several products can share.

Outside work I do research in medical imaging, and I'm first author on a paper about a multimodal Transformer for Alzheimer's diagnosis. I'm an AI enthusiast, so I also built a chatbot in React. When I find a gap in what I know, I learn it and ship something with it.

highlights: Maintain 5 microservices across the backend, and resolve UI-related bugs in the Angular interfaces whenever they come up.
Developed features that several teams use, including the GraphQL layer and the common data browser.
Implemented 20+ GraphQL queries, mutations and resolvers in Java and Spring Boot for industrial dashboards, reusing the existing REST service layer so business logic stays in one place.
Built the common data browser in TypeScript and RxJS. 3 products use it to browse historian data from IoT devices and to select and configure data sources.
Cut duplicated UI code by about 40% by separating data access from presentation and making the component configurable through inputs.
Resolved 30+ defects across Angular interfaces and Java backend APIs by debugging end to end and finding root causes.
Worked in a 7-person Agile team on sprint planning and code reviews, shipping through Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.

experience.summary: Project: Creating a custom IP core and integrating it with the system.
highlights: Designed FPGA logic models in VHDL, then simulated, synthesized and implemented them using Vivado and ISE.
Learned how FPGA logic blocks and LUTs work by implementing designs in Vivado and ISE.
Integrated hardware and software designs to build a custom IP core on a Virtex-5 ML507 FPGA.
Built custom IP cores for an OR gate and a full adder.

research.title: Multimodal Transformer for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis
research.venue: First author of three. Presented at IEEE INDISCON 2026, MNIT Jaipur
highlights: Preprocessed sMRI and fMRI scans of 150 subjects from the ADNI dataset into a paired multimodal dataset for classification.
Converted 4D fMRI into masked time series for a Transformer encoder and processed 3D sMRI with a CNN, then combined both with attention-based feature fusion and dense classification layers.
